title: theme.json — visual identity and optional voice/cast tokens

brand.description: Series name shown top-left and as the page title.

series_kicker.description: Small tagline on the title card.

fonts.description: Font filenames in engine/assets/fonts (default Noto Sans) or absolute paths.

palette.description: Each token is an [r,g,b] (0-255). Keep high contrast (ink vs panel/bg). The theme-validation in theme.py checks this.

visual.description: Restrained surface treatment. Scene geometry remains engine-owned; only quiz geometry is globally frozen.

world.description: Optional narrative vocabulary retained for story-based courses and v1 compatibility.

center_label.description: The protected center on a map scene.

group_role_label.description: What a group's persona is called.

source_label.description: Default citation prefix for concept cards.

groups.description: Optional method-of-loci grouping for multi-topic COURSES (single videos omit it).

cast.description: Optional voice roster. A direct course normally has one NARRATOR entry; fictional characters are not required.

role.description: Fictional roles are optional. antagonist/villain/threat receive special audio treatment.

piper.description: piper .onnx voice name in assets/voices/ (used only with the approved CC_TTS=piper downgrade).

spell_acronyms.description: acronyms to spell out letter-by-letter when spoken.

music.description: Map episodes to SOURCED tracks in assets/music/ (public-domain/CC only).
